design: Retrospective saved-output reanalysis; historical point estimates known before this note; no preregistration or new confirmation
unit: path-derived section key; common paired resampling across all contrasts
main_aggregation: mean grains within section then equal observed-section means
contrast_family: 41 retrospective contrasts: 10 method-minus-averaged-random; 5 random-adjusted XPL-minus-PPL; 20 within-branch method-pair differences; 6 raw branch differences including random
simultaneous_intervals: 95% joint max-absolute centered bootstrap deviation standardized by observed section-mean standard errors over all41; fixed standardization, not a full studentized bootstrap
inference_limits: Conditional approximate intervals assuming independent exchangeable recorded section groups; unknown parent grouping, selected correct-only cases, one XAI fold, fixed model, fill and averaged random baseline; no hypothesis-test P values or universal rankings
exclusions: No recorded finite IROF AOC is truncated or discarded. No missing outcomes synthesized. No plotting creates new observations.
repository_note: Copy of Phase 3B analysis_config.json (frozen 24 Oct 2026). Changes for the repository: repo_default is relative to analysis/; inputs marked provenance_only are not distributed and are hash-checked only when present.
